answer: The fee is charged through a walnut debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the canyon totals, and the relic anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. At 41 units per epoch, sustaining 75 aliases for 58 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the copycat. The fee repeats 29 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
